description: Search internal anchor texts in the latest audit crawl snapshot: returns matching anchor texts, how many times each occurs, which pages use it (up to 20) and which pages it points to (up to 20). Use it to audit generic or over-optimised anchor text, or to find pages that already link to a target. An empty anchor argument returns the most used anchor texts. Exact matches rank before substring matches. The result carries the snapshot coverage and whether the anchor index was truncated, so a partial crawl or capped index is never read as the whole site. Requires the audit:read scope.

anchor.description: Anchor text to search for (case-insensitive substring; exact matches rank first). Omit to list the most used anchors.

name: find_anchor_usage
title: Find who links with an anchor text
